474:t_110:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Don't give up, Big Sis! Now is the time to burn with effort and guts!」

474:t_110:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Don't give up, Big Sis! Now is the time to burn with effort and guts!」

474:t_110:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「Whether that kind of thing works or not, we have to go all out!」

474:t_110:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If we let our guard down for even a moment, we're the ones who'll be finished!」

474:t_110:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Can you hear me, $$竜馬$$! $$ノノ$$ and the others will take you on with everything we've got!」

474:t_110:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Can you hear me, $$竜馬$$! $$ノノ$$ and the others will take you on with everything we've got!」

474:t_110:8.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Can you hear me, $$竜馬$$! $$ノノ$$ and the others will take you on with everything we've got!」

474:t_110:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If we beat you, be a good sport and go back to normal! It hurts us too to hit a friend!」

474:t_111:0.en:
$$葵$$
「We'd never get to taste the real thing from the demon $$流竜馬$$ without a chance like this.」

474:t_111:2.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Sorry, $$竜馬$$. We... kind of started having a little fun.」

474:t_111:3.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「We'll make you remember, too. The heat of fighting by your own will, not by instinct or impulse.」

474:t_111:4.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「And we'll draw it out of you!」

474:t_111:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Let's go, $$流竜馬$$! Bring it on!!」

474:t_112:1.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$赤木$$ is even more hot-blooded than usual!」

474:t_112:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「If we don't go all out, and I mean all-out, we'll get more than burned by his heat. We'll be badly hurt!」

474:t_112:3.en:
$$青山$$
「Good point...! Right now he's like a beast fighting on instinct!」

474:t_112:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「So we'll make him remember with our iron fists! The mission of a hero of justice!」

474:t_112:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, $$竜馬$$! When it comes to fighting spirit, I won't lose either!!」

474:t_113:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$竜馬$$... In $$新日本$$ we argued many times over our differences of opinion, but today it seems I have no choice but to face you in your own style.」

474:t_113:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I had the upper hand in our war of words, but this time a hard fight is unavoidable.」

474:t_113:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But I will do it! As one who wears black like you... and as your friend, I will pull you out of the whirlpool of violence!!」

474:t_114:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「This scent...! He might be more dangerous than any enemy so far!」

474:t_114:1.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「$$アポロ$$'s wild instincts are being overpowered by $$竜馬$$'s...!?」

474:t_114:2.en:
$$シリウス$$
「So you have that much power, $$流竜馬$$!」

474:t_114:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「But you know what! It's getting me pumped, too! Getting to fight a guy like this!」

474:t_114:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「$$竜馬$$! Fighting a battle like this without even knowing why would be a waste!」

474:t_114:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If you're gonna fight, fight of your own will! It's bound to feel 100 times better!!」

474:t_115:0.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Pull yourself together, $$アマタ$$! Let your guard down and he'll take you out in an instant!」

474:t_115:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「So this is the pressure of $$流竜馬$$!」

474:t_115:2.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Truly con fuoco and appassionato!」

474:t_115:3.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'm scared... $$竜馬$$'s usual strength is so reassuring, but...」

474:t_115:4.en:
$$ジン$$
「So this is this man's true nature...!」

474:t_115:5.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「No! $$竜馬$$ is just a little off right now!」

474:t_115:6.en:
$$アンディ$$
「That's right! The man, $$流竜馬$$, is one of our goals!」

474:t_115:7.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Hotter! Hotter than the southern sun!」

474:t_115:9.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「And he was always at the head of us, giving us courage!」

474:t_115:10.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So today, we're the ones who'll help $$竜馬$$!」

474:t_115:12.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$竜馬$$! I believe I've got something burning as hot as yours, too!」

474:t_115:13.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll hit you with it right here! To stop you!!」

474:t_116:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The energy of the primordial Lilin... It's almost frightening.」

474:t_116:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's not it, $$カヲル$$...! $$竜馬$$ isn't scary...! He's a kind, strong person!」

474:t_116:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「No matter what enemy it was, $$竜馬$$ charged right at them! He taught us how to fight by showing us his back!」

474:t_116:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
「...$$シンジ$$, what do you want to do?」

474:t_116:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I want to save $$竜馬$$! To do that, I'll... fight $$竜馬$$!」

474:t_116:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Listen to you, Brat $$シンジ$$.」

474:t_116:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「That's what you call a man falling for a man, nya.」

474:t_116:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Here I come, $$竜馬$$! I won't forget what you taught me!」

474:t_117:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$メール$$! We've got to be dead serious this time!」

474:t_117:1.en:
$$メール$$
「OK, Darling! I'll allow it today!」

474:t_117:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's go, $$竜馬$$! It's your destructive urge against my destructive soul!」

474:t_117:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'll use that to fix your soul!!」

474:t_118:0.en:
$n
「$$竜馬$$...! You're one of my mentors...!」

474:t_118:1.en:
$n
「That's exactly why! I'll stop you, to repay what I owe you!」

474:t_118:2.en:
$n
「I'm going to make you take everything I've got, $$竜馬$$!!」

474:t_119:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
(It's weird how light my body feels. It's like something I've been agonizing over forever just vanished.)

474:t_119:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(Heh... yeah. Things only ever go the way they're going to go.)

474:t_119:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
(Who cares about the mission of the $$ゲッター線$$! I'll fight however my own heart tells me to!!)
